mathematical_review.control_response_scaling: D=diag(1/sqrt(Kii)); Cbar=G*C*D; q=D*y; physical gauge lambda=G*lambda_scaled; equations impose C*q=0 and q[82]=1
mathematical_review.trace_identity: J=Hplus-Hminus; normal opening row alpha_i=2*sqrt(-x_i/R) at coefficient 82; no projection
mathematical_review.force_balance: only index 82 is controlled; non-control generalized force is gated; positive force is Kq+C.T*lambda+f_gamma at index 82
mathematical_review.work_balance: independent exact piecewise-linear cohesive work vs primitive cumulative work; exact quadratic bulk work plus cohesive work vs stored+dissipated energy change
mathematical_review.history: commits trial states after each step and checks irreversible damage/kappa
mathematical_review.zero_opening_tangent: recorded as a corner observation; not used in a solve

limitations_or_external_gates: K symmetry is inherited from the immutable previously accepted pinned result; this driver does not recheck it locally.
The internal wall timer excludes argument parsing, pin/case reads, result serialization, disk write, and stdout; use an external whole-process watchdog.
The 8 MiB limit applies to the result payload, not combined file and stdout output; enforce combined accounting externally.
The exclusive output create occurs after numerical work and does not itself enforce retries=0; invoke under an external one-shot guard.
Failed-run metadata omits partial primitive-attempt counts; the successful loop has at most 12 calls.
scope: fixed-face global Mode-I opening-history toy only; no crack-growth, material-qualification, roughness, multibody, or general-fracture claim
